newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia T-bill yields at Wed sale seen market level.
newsitem.headline: Russia T-bill yields at Wed sale seen market level.

text.p: Yields on Russian GKO discount Treasury bills at auctions on Wednesday will be in line with current market levels, dealers said on Tuesday.
TOMORROW
Finance Ministry sells:
*4.00 trln rbls 364-day T-bill (series 22084)
*7.00 trln rbls 168-day T-bill (series 23007)
Finance Ministry repays:
*7.00 trln rbls 238-day T-bills (series 22051)
TODAY
*Average yield fell to 25.2 pct from 25.7 pct on Monday
*Turnover rose to 5.06 trln rbls from 3.63 trln rbls
*The Central Bank sold 97.00 bln rbls in OFZ interest-bearing bonds (series 24011 and 24012)

Dealers forecast the average yield on the series 22084 T-bills, maturing on November 5, 1997, would be in 25.34-26.66 percent. Series 22083 bills, maturing on November 12, 1997, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed at 88.80 on Tuesday to yield 26.16 percent.
The average yield of the series 23007 T-bills, maturing on May 20, 1998, would be in 26.28-27.43 percent, they said.
Series 23006 bills, maturing on May 6, the closest maturity date to the 23007 bills, on Tuesday closed at 79.52 to yield 26.78 percent.
Dealers said demand for the rouble at the overnight credits market and pre-auction dollar sales testified to potential non-resident demand for the 364-day T-bill.

"Non-residents are interested in any paper which matures after January 1, 1999, as they do not need to hedge and they can get a full hard currency yield," said Raiffeisen Bank, Austria dealer Alexander Losev.
"Currently the yield level, which attracts them, is 22-23 percent on long-term taxable issues."

Dealers said the market was ready for prices to ease and that Russian operators had already taken profits in short and medium-term issues. But the T-bill market was the only place for rouble investment, they said.
"The big rouble remainders we saw in the trading system on Monday and Tuesday is only Russian money, which has nowhere else to go," said Rossiisky Kredit Bank dealer Konstantin Svyatny.
--Anna Smirnova, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
